subject: Mini-escrow / evidence bundle for private deployment pilot
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@luminahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Conway <julia.conway@luminahealth.com>, Lumina Health Legal <legal@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private pilot — request for condensed escrow/evidence package

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the isolation model. Before our procurement team will sign the pilot order form, they have asked for a short "mini-escrow" style package that demonstrates how Redwood would provide proofs of operational continuity and operator access controls for an on-prem/private deployment.

Key asks from procurement/legal (high level):
- A short inventory of artifacts you can provide for a pilot (e.g., witness-runbook, sealed snapshot process, operator access attestation).
- A short timeline (1–2 week) for delivering those artifacts for a pilot scope limited to a single datacenter/VPC.
- Confirmation of what you can commit to in the Order Form exhibits versus what requires an MSA annex.

We are aiming to start the pilot the week of Oct 25. If we can get a condensed package and a proposed schedule by Oct 15, procurement can move forward with a limited approval.

Can you share how you typically approach a lightweight escrow-like proof for pilots? If you prefer, we can hop on a short call tomorrow.

Sam
Sam Patel
Director, Infrastructure Procurement
Lumina Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Julia Conway <julia.conway@luminahealth.com>, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private pilot — request for condensed escrow/evidence package

Sam — appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely support a constrained pilot-level evidence bundle that addresses procurement's questions without requiring a full legal escrow exhibit up front.

High level plan (short):
- Deliverable package by Oct 20: evidence_matrix.xlsx (artifact inventory + confidence level), "proposed-mini-escrow-exhibit.pdf" (contract language for an Order Form exhibit that covers the pilot), and a short witness runbook excerpt.
- Two small attestation items: (1) operator access attestation (signed by ops), (2) snapshot procedure description with validation steps.
- A 30-minute signoff call the week of Oct 19 to walk procurement/legal through the artifacts.

I’m looping in Prriyom (ops) and our contracts lead for legal alignment. If that timeline works for you I’ll kick off the internal redline work and send the draft exhibit + artifact matrix.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private pilot — request for condensed escrow/evidence package

Team — forwarding Lumina's ask. They want a very small "mini-escrow" bundle to unblock a pilot (single VPC/datacenter) and a quick timeline. We should avoid committing to full escrow terms or onerous delivery in the Order Form; the ask should be satisfiable via an Order Form exhibit + attestation for the pilot.

Proposed internal split:
- Contracts (Lauren): draft a short exhibit for the Order Form that lists the pilot artifacts we will provide and a limited liability/availability carveout for the pilot period. No changes to MSA core IP language.
- Ops (Prriyom): produce the evidence_matrix.xlsx and sign the operator access attestation. Identify any demo-only artifacts (e.g., sealed snapshot steps, witness runbook excerpt).
- Security/Legal (Karthik): quick review of the exhibit language and attestation text; flag anything that needs MSA Annex vs Order Form.

Questions/notes:
- We should be explicit in the exhibit that the deliverables are for pilot validation and do not convey broader deployment rights.
- If Lumina asks for an escrow deposit or third-party custodian, we should offer an alternative: time-limited sealed snapshot + witnessed checksum + on-call validation by our engineering lead. That is lower friction for a pilot.

Can each of you confirm capacity to deliver by Oct 20? If possible I’ll package the first drafts and set up the Oct 19 signoff slot.

Thanks — Marissa

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private pilot — request for condensed escrow/evidence package

Can confirm we can own the Order Form exhibit draft. A few drafting guardrails I’ll follow:
- "Pilot Exhibit" will enumerate deliverables and explicitly state: "Artifacts provided are solely for the scope and term of the pilot and do not constitute transfer of deployment rights or model residency."
- Add a short acceptance criterion for each artifact (e.g., "witness runbook excerpt: reviewed and acknowledged by customer; sealed-snapshot: checksum verified by both parties").
- Keep liability carveouts narrow for pilot scope; no change to MSA indemnities.

Karthik — please flag any redlines you want in the attestation language. Prriyom — if you can post the evidence matrix by Oct 19 EOD that gives me time to draft the exhibit on the 20th.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference

To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Julia Conway <julia.conway@luminahealth.com>, Lumina Health Legal <legal@luminahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Prriyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot — request for condensed escrow/evidence package

Sam / Julia — quick update and attached drafts.

What we will provide for the pilot (deliverables attached):
- evidence_matrix.xlsx — inventory of artifacts mapped to acceptance criteria and delivery date (attached).
- proposed-mini-escrow-exhibit.pdf — short Order Form exhibit that lists the pilot artifacts and clearly limits the rights to the pilot term.
- operator access attestation (signed by ops) — included as a single-page PDF in the evidence matrix.
- witness runbook excerpt and snapshot checksum procedure (described in the matrix).

Timeline:
- Oct 19 — 30-minute signoff call (please confirm a time window that works for you).
- Oct 20 — final delivery of materials; procurement review complete by Oct 22 so we can start the pilot the week of Oct 25 as requested.

Notes/constraints:
- The exhibit is intentionally scoped to the pilot and does not modify MSA IP/derivative language. Any request for a third-party escrow custodian or permanent on-prem escrow would need an MSA annex and longer legal lead time.
- If Lumina wants an additional verification step (e.g., remote witness session during snapshot creation) we can accommodate that during the pilot week for a short, mutually agreed window.

Next steps:
1) Sam — please confirm availability for a 30-minute call on Oct 19 (AM or PM pacific).
2) Lumina legal — if you have immediate redline concerns on the exhibit, send markups to lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com.
3) Prriyom will post the evidence_matrix.xlsx and operator attestation today.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this pilot started.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
